candidates.instruction: Keep `counter` as an 8-bit register, but replace iteration 1’s unconditional modulo increment with an explicit `counter == 8'hff` branch that sets it to zero; otherwise increment by one. Preserve the synchronous reset and `pwm_out <= (counter < {24'd0, duty})` update exactly. This is an area experiment: promote only if all gates pass and routed LUTs are strictly below 7; matching 7 LUTs is not an objective improvement.
